sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Gripping first-hand testimonies walk through the events of the 2018 poisoning. Plus: a campfire showdown in Survivor Australia. Here’s what to watch this evening 9pm, Sky Documentaries “I said to myself: ‘Don’t worry, nothing happens in Salisbury,’” remembers journalist Emma Volney of her first week in local radio in 2018. “You don’t expect to see two people on a bench foaming at the mouth.” This documentary uses first-hand testimony to walk through the events of the poisoning of former Russian spy Sergei Skripal and his daughter Yulia. The former prime minister Theresa May, intelligence officials and counterterrorism leaders also speak about the incident. Hollie Richardson Continue reading...
